additional_info.subject: ID0379343-DC/Si-D/PL[PWnLON] - Converter not found, CanCommLoss CRM:00315001766
additional_info.body:
Hi Szymon, good morning.
The reason why is that due to a charger reboot, the CAN allocation is different. So what you always need to check is the Serial Number of the converter.
So as your example, the first time the error occured you had in [5] index. But after a reboot, the CAN allocation, which is performed randomly, allocated to the [7] index.
When will you be going on-site? Please bring a new converter with you in case we need to replace it.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
